name: Universal Logistics / LINC - Sturtevant Contract Logistics Warehouse - Sturtevant WI

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open site. The building sits behind a wide grass setback on a business-park road; truck driveways connect directly to the public road with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point. No perimeter fence on the east frontage.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at any driveway. Street View of the east frontage and the south end shows only open paved aprons and a small office at the south corner of the building - no 1-3-space booth structure.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on the NE/east face (Werner trailers + container backed in) and on the west face (yard full of CNH agricultural material) are physically separate building faces - inbound material vs outbound flow appear split.
fieldNotes.dropYard: West-side yard is full of stored agricultural-equipment material on stands and stacked freight (CNH/Case New Holland account) plus parked trailers; east lot holds a row of ~8+ drop trailers - dedicated trailer/material storage separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimate from overhead - building is ~1300+ ft long with dock banks on both long faces; ~70 doors is an honest midpoint, flagged low-confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Racine County business park (Sturtevant/Mount Pleasant); farmland and open fields immediately south and west. Small-town industrial setting -> Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale visible in the truck path.
